# Coffee brewing guide

Use a ratio of 1:16 coffee to water. Grind medium for pour-over and coarse for a French press.

## Pour-over

Bloom the grounds for thirty seconds, then pour in slow circles. Total brew time should be about three minutes.

## Cold brew

Steep coarse grounds in cold water for sixteen hours in the fridge, then filter. See [[sourdough-starter]] for another slow kitchen project.
